$comment: pdf/body-size on real built papers. `papers`: accepted papers whose built PDF must draw no finding, each with the size its source declares, the size pdf.js reads off the rendered glyphs (the mode of a body page and of a reference page, weighted by characters), and what banal measured into the facts. `variants`: one of those papers with ONE change to a font size, and the exact findings it must draw. Built and linted by test/e2e/tex/page-count.e2e.ts; each edit's `find` must occur exactly once. The rendered sizes were read with pdf.js (text items' transform scale), not by the rule, and the reference pages were looked at: banal reads every size 0.3 pt above what the glyphs are set in.
